summary: Phase 4 Investor Portal Frontend testing complete. All 16 features verified working: login page, error handling, valid credentials redirect, satellite map with city labels, minimal PortalLayout (no CRM sidebar), DL logo + portal name + logout in header, asset type filter pills auto-populated, saved toggle filter, welcome badge with investor name/count, deal detail page with property info, save/unsave functionality, back to map navigation, logout clears session, and zero editing capabilities.

portal_login_page.page_renders: PASS - Login form at /portal/{portalId} with name + access code inputs
portal_login_page.data_testids: PASS - portal-login-name, portal-login-code, portal-login-submit all present
portal_login_page.submit_disabled_when_empty: PASS - Submit button correctly disabled when form empty
portal_login_page.invalid_credentials_error: PASS - Shows 'Invalid access code' error message with data-testid='portal-login-error'
portal_login_page.valid_credentials_redirect: PASS - Redirects to /portal/{portalId}/map after successful login

portal_map_page.satellite_imagery: PASS - Map shows satellite imagery from ESRI tiles
portal_map_page.city_labels: PASS - City labels visible (SAN ANTONIO, SCHERTZ, SEGUIN, NEW BRAUNFELS, etc.)
portal_map_page.welcome_badge: PASS - Shows 'Welcome, UI Test Investor · 1 deal'

header_elements.dl_logo: PASS - DealLinked logo visible in header
header_elements.portal_name: PASS - 'SA Investor Deals' displayed in header

portal_map_page.saved_toggle: PASS - data-testid='saved-toggle' works, filters to '0 deals' when active
portal_map_page.asset_type_filters: PASS - 'Office' filter auto-populated from portal deals with data-testid='filter-Office'
portal_map_page.map_pins: INFO - No pins visible as test deal has no lat/lng coordinates (expected behavior)

deal_detail_page.save_button: PASS - data-testid='detail-save-btn' toggles between 'Save to Watchlist' and 'Saved'
deal_detail_page.address_display: PASS - '123 Main St, San Antonio, TX' address displayed
deal_detail_page.documents_section: INFO - Not present (deal has no documents - expected)

minimal_portal_layout.no_crm_sidebar: PASS - No Dashboard, Contacts, Pipeline, Settings, or Team navigation visible
minimal_portal_layout.header_only: PASS - Only minimal header bar with logo, portal name, and logout

logout_functionality.logout_clears_session: PASS - Clicking logout redirects to login page
logout_functionality.session_protection: PASS - Accessing /map after logout redirects back to login

no_editing_capabilities.no_edit_buttons: PASS - 0 edit buttons found on portal pages

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 Investor Portal Frontend fully working. Portal 'SA Investor Deals' has 1 deal (Test Property - Office, $1.5M, no lat/lng so no map pin). Login flow: /portal/{id} -> fill name/code -> /portal/{id}/map. PortalLayout is minimal (no CRM sidebar). Session stored in localStorage as portal_session_{id}. All data-testids correctly implemented. Backend investor API endpoints all working: auth, deals list, deal detail, save/unsave, activity logging.
